characters.description: A silver-rank outworlder and adventurer leading his team through monster-clearance work in the depleted Storm Kingdom. His unusually forceful aura and soul-linked abilities let him drive dangerous creatures from concealment.
characters.name: Jason Asano

characters.description: Jason's formation specialist and teammate. She examines the failed defences of a massacred fortress town with Belinda and Clive, helping establish that insiders deliberately drained the protective system.
characters.name: Farrah Hurin

characters.description: The defender and field leader of Jason's team. When Clive notices gaps in Jason's account of his altered soul, Humphrey respects Jason's privacy and advises against pressing him for answers.
characters.name: Humphrey Geller

characters.description: A swift silver-rank striker on Jason's team. She joins the investigation of the fortress-town massacre, where missing defenders and deliberately disabled protections indicate an organized betrayal.
characters.name: Sophie Wexler

characters.description: A tactical specialist and covert operator on Jason's team. Her examination of the fortress controls helps reveal that authorized users drained their power and disguised the sabotage as ordinary system exhaustion.
characters.name: Belinda Callahan

characters.description: The team's combat caster and astral-magic researcher. Deeply affected by the fortress massacre, he is admitted to Jason's spirit realm, an exceptional sign of trust that immediately engages his scholarly curiosity.
characters.name: Clive Standish

characters.description: The healer on Jason's team. His healing senses help locate the sole survivor of the fortress-town attack, and he assists a local healer in stabilizing the critically injured patient.
characters.name: Neil Devone

characters.description: A gold-rank healer who recognizes the psychological cost of disaster work. After the fortress-town massacre, she begins trauma-support sessions for the returning adventurers.
characters.name: Arabelle Remore

characters.description: Jason's smith ally, commonly called Gary. Knowledge from his childhood links a captive with a false human aura to the Order of Redeeming Light and its practice of remaking elves and celestines as human-presenting adherents.
characters.name: Gareth Xandier

characters.description: A gold-rank stealth specialist who commands the expedition into the fallen Builder city near Rimaros. She is alert to hidden construct threats and is still grieving Vesper's death in the earlier battle for the city.
characters.name: Liara Rimaros

characters.description: A deceased Rimaros royal operative remembered during the return to the fallen Builder city. Her death while ensuring a weapon reached the city's core remains central to Liara's grief.
characters.name: Vesper Rimaros

characters.description: The local leader of the Order of Redeeming Light. She directs the Builder Island raid to obtain clockwork kings, while also pursuing a personal objective involving her daughter that has caused dissent among other Order cells.
characters.name: Melody Jane

characters.description: Melody Jane's second-in-command in the local Order of Redeeming Light. She commands one of the landing groups sent onto Builder Island with controlled servitors and gold-rank converted fighters.
characters.name: Sendira

characters.description: The leader of Team WorkSaw, a fellow adventuring team fighting the Order on Builder Island. After the first engagement, he questions why the enemy risked a direct clash with two complete teams.
characters.name: Carlos Quilido

characters.description: Jason's trusted shadow familiar, able to divide into expendable bodies for dangerous reconnaissance. After Jason frees an Order captive, Shade's bodies secretly follow the captors to learn their escape route.
characters.name: Shade

characters.description: A gold-rank portal specialist covertly serving the Order of Redeeming Light. From a concealed island, he provides the remote portal that extracts Sendira and the captured clockwork kings.
characters.name: Esteban Gallo

characters.description: An adventurer taken alive from Builder Island and a cousin of Liara's husband. He remains in the Order's custody after its forces escape with two clockwork kings.
characters.name: Gibson Amuz

characters.description: A newly promoted silver-rank Adventure Society official assigned to the Office of Organised Enemy Response. His liaison experience leads to his appointment as Sophie's debriefer on the Purity investigation.
characters.name: Vidal Ladiv

characters.description: An adventurer ally and trainer known to Jason's circle. His prior connection to a gold-rank visitor seeking access to Sophie places him close to a sensitive inquiry concerning her missing mother.
characters.name: Rufus Remore

characters.description: Liara Rimaros's husband and a defender of the Amuz mining complex. When the Order raids the mine, he works to secure personnel in safe rooms and attempts to reach the dock to alert Liara.
characters.name: Baseph Rimaros

characters.description: Jason's leech familiar with extraordinary regenerative power. During Jason's catastrophic mana overflow, Colin replaces ruined limbs and their magical structure, buying the healers time to save him.
characters.name: Colin

characters.description: Jason's eye familiar, acting as emergency magical support when the forced portal leaves Jason dying. Gordon removes ruined limbs and creates an unfamiliar ritual that begins drawing off the destructive excess mana.
characters.name: Gordon

characters.description: A powerful observer who watches Jason's recovery crisis without intervening. She judges him safe inside the transformed cloud temple and avoids further direct action that would restrict what she can do later.
characters.name: Dawn

characters.description: An outworlder ally from Earth who joins the force preparing to strike the Order's mountain stronghold. He commits to the operation while Jason remains unconscious under specialist care.
characters.name: Taika

characters.description: An Earth outworlder and technical collaborator in Jason's wider circle. He joins the allies preparing to support Liara's assault on the Order stronghold while Jason is unable to fight.
characters.name: Travis Noble

characters.description: A gold-rank assault adventurer known as the Siege Sword. He opens the attack on the Order's compromised mountain refuge by blasting a direct breach through the mountain.
characters.name: Trenchant Moore

characters.description: A diamond-rank vessel sent to represent the Builder under temporary release. He arrives to reclaim the authority bound to Jason, but the token violently rejects his attempt to seize it.
characters.name: Shako

characters.description: A figure associated with the Sundered Throne. She authorizes Shako's temporary release so he can serve as the Builder's representative because a replacement Prime Vessel is not ready.
characters.name: Carmen

characters.description: A diamond-rank elder of the Rimaros family who favours treating Jason carefully while he is still silver rank, since Jason may later reach diamond rank and remember how he was treated.
characters.name: Soramir Rimaros

characters.description: Jason's independent associate, shielded by Mayor Pelli from external pressure. After hearing from an acquaintance, she postpones their discussion until Jason has recovered.
characters.name: Estella Warnock
